01 Editor's Letter

A Note From Salim Alpha

Salim AlphaFounder & Publisher

Welcome to The Alpha Standard.

It started simply. A coach and his clients.

But somewhere along the way something shifted. The people I was training stopped being just clients. They became family. And when a group of people become family — something beautiful happens. They start showing up for each other in ways that go far beyond the gym.

We celebrate each other. We cherish each other. We value each other.

From that family came a desire to celebrate. To gather not as coach and clients — but as people who had been through something together. That became the Alpha Gala. Every year we dress up, we sit together, we laugh, we celebrate how far we've come. We look at each other and ask — do you remember where you started? That moment of genuine gratitude, of joy, of seeing each other's growth — that is what the Gala is about.

That spirit of togetherness grew into something bigger — Alpha Community. A space where everyone knows each other, supports each other, celebrates each other.

And just this year — that community took its first steps outside the gym walls. Alpha Adventures was born. We are now exploring Rwanda together. Going beyond our comfort zones. Discovering that a strong life is built everywhere — not just in training.

And now we are asking an even bigger question. What happens when a community stops serving only itself and starts asking what it can give to the world around it? How do we contribute to our society beyond fitness, beyond our circle?

That question is driving us forward today.

If you are reading this — you are welcome here. Whether you come for the coaching, the adventures, the community, or simply to be part of something that genuinely cares — there is a place for you.

As God allows — we keep growing.
